card.name: Rato Gigante
card.summary: Ao ser destruído em batalha e enviado ao Cemitério, você pode Invocar do Deck 1 monstro de EARTH com 1500 ATK ou menos em Ataque.

textEvidence.text: Giant Rat has one optional Trigger Effect. Only when it is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, its controller can activate a Chain Link to Special Summon one EARTH monster with 1500 or less original ATK directly from their Deck, in face-up Attack Position. Activation does not target the Deck; the player chooses an eligible Deck card upon resolution, then the Deck is shuffled. If the effect is declined, the Deck has no eligible card, or the Monster Zones have no space, it does not summon. A destruction by card effect is not battle destruction. No discard or Life Point payment is required. Skill Drain on the field does not negate the effect activated in the Graveyard.
